description:
Nestled within the scenic hills of the highly sought-after Calabasas Highlands, this beautifully designed French Contemporary residence blends timeless elegance with warm California living. Offering 4 bedrooms, 3 bathrooms, and approximately 2,765 square feet of thoughtfully curated living space, the home captures picturesque canyon and hillside views while delivering privacy, comfort, and an exceptional indoor-outdoor lifestyle.
Filled with natural light, the home features soaring ceilings, expansive formal living and dining rooms, rich hardwood floors throughout, and an ideal floor plan designed for both entertaining and everyday living. A spacious family room flows seamlessly into the kitchen and surrounding gathering spaces, creating an inviting atmosphere throughout the home. Upstairs, all four bedrooms are thoughtfully positioned together on the second level, including a spacious primary suite that serves as a peaceful retreat overlooking the surrounding natural beauty. Outside, enjoy multiple fruit trees, tranquil surroundings, and close proximity to some of the area’s most beloved hiking and nature trails, offering the perfect balance of relaxation and outdoor adventure. Ideally located with convenient access to the 101 Freeway, Malibu beaches, Calabasas, and the Westside, the property is also positioned near award-winning Las Virgenes schools as well as prestigious private institutions including Viewpoint School. Blending classic French-inspired architecture with contemporary comfort, scenic views, and an unbeatable location, this Calabasas Highlands home offers a rare opportunity to experience elevated canyon living moments from the best of both Calabasas and Malibu.
